title: A Vow for the Summer
author: Rosalind Voss
blurb: Orsen Marchetti, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
